name: Shinkurou
source:
Current chairman of the Shimura Club, residing in the world where time has stopped.

[spoiler]In truth he's an RSD projection controlled by Maina, who is the real chairman of the Shimura Club. His appearance is based off Ootemachi.[/spoiler]
